Two days later Enhancv released a Resume MCP, a connector built on the Model Context Protocol that lets Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants work with a job seeker's Enhancv resume, job search results and application tracker in one place (EIN Presswire). The company says the connector tells the assistant to use only facts the candidate supplied, a response to assistants inventing achievements.
  • General chat assistants. Many people simply ask a chatbot to suggest job titles, list companies hiring in a city, or compare two offers. That is useful for brainstorming but the answers are only as current as the assistant's search results, so always click through to the employer's own site.

Why scam detection is now part of the job

Fake listings have grown alongside AI tools. The Better Business Bureau's 2026 employment scam study counted 23,234 reports to its Scam Tracker in 2025, roughly double the 11,748 reported in 2024, with text message scams making up half of all reports and a median loss of $1,000 (BBB study coverage). Its red flags are worth memorizing: unprompted offers, a job with no interview, pay that is too good to be true, interviewers who will not turn on a camera, and any request for money before you are paid. The same fraud runs in the other direction, too, with fake candidates targeting employers, which we explain in deepfake job candidates.

What employers are doing about AI powered searching

Recruiters feel the volume. Business Insider reported on November 25, 2026 that a remote engineering opening at Tines drew about 2,000 applications in under 24 hours, and that its recruiter began hiding a line of white text in job postings asking AI agents not to apply (Business Insider). Expect more of this: hidden instructions in postings, stricter screening questions, and more weight on referrals. Employers are also searching harder for people who are not job hunting at all, using AI sourcing software that finds candidates from public profiles and reaches them by email or text. For a job seeker, that means a complete, accurate public profile is part of a search strategy, not an afterthought.

How to use AI for job search without wasting time

  1. Describe the job, not the title. Give the assistant the problems you want to work on, the industries you know and your location limits. Ask for adjacent titles you might be missing.
  2. Verify every posting at the source. Find the same role on the employer's careers page before you apply. If you cannot, treat it as a risk.
  3. Keep the facts yours. If an assistant drafts or tailors your resume, check every number. Employers increasingly screen for AI written applications, as our explainer on AI generated resumes describes.
  4. Track and prune. Use a tracker, AI powered or a spreadsheet, and drop roles with no response after two weeks instead of reapplying.
  5. Protect your data. Never share bank details, ID scans or Social Security numbers before a verified offer, and be wary of chat apps that ask you to move off the job platform.

The limits

Matching scores are only as good as the data behind them, and a ghost risk label is an estimate, not proof. AI tools also cannot tell you whether a hiring manager has already picked an internal candidate. Use them to narrow the list, then spend your effort on the few applications where you can reach a real person.

faq.q: What is AI job search?
faq.a: Using AI to describe the work you want in plain language, get ranked job matches, flag suspicious postings and track applications, before you write any application.

faq.q: What is a ghost job?
faq.a: A posting for a role that is not actually open. Enhancv's 2026 study found 47% of U.S. job seekers had applied to one.

faq.q: Are AI job search tools safe to use?
faq.a: Most are, but treat them as a filter. Confirm each job on the employer's own careers page and never pay or share bank details to get hired.

faq.q: How common are job scams in 2026?
faq.a: The BBB counted 23,234 employment scam reports in 2025, about double 2024, with text message scams making up half.

faq.q: Can ChatGPT or Claude search for jobs for me?
faq.a: They can suggest titles and companies and, through connectors such as Enhancv's Resume MCP, work with a job board and tracker. Always check the listing at the source.
